info.name: CoinGecko Crypto Market Data Asset Platforms Simple API

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of CoinGecko coin IDs (e.g., bitcoin,ethereum)

params.name: vs_currencies
params.description: Comma-separated list of target currencies (e.g., usd,eur,btc)

params.name: include_market_cap
params.description: Include market cap in the response

params.name: include_24hr_vol
params.description: Include 24-hour trading volume in the response

params.name: include_24hr_change
params.description: Include 24-hour price change percentage in the response

params.name: include_last_updated_at
params.description: Include last updated timestamp in the response

params.name: precision
params.description: Decimal precision for currency price values (0-18)

items.docs: Query the prices of one or more coins by using their unique CoinGecko coin IDs. Optionally include market cap, 24h volume, 24h change, and last updated timestamp.

info.name: Get token price by contract address

params.name: id
params.description: The asset platform ID (e.g., ethereum, polygon-pos, solana)

params.name: contract_addresses
params.description: Comma-separated list of token contract addresses on the specified asset platform

params.name: vs_currencies
params.description: Comma-separated list of target currencies (e.g., usd,eur,btc)

params.name: include_market_cap
params.description: Include market cap in the response

params.name: include_24hr_vol
params.description: Include 24-hour trading volume in the response

params.name: include_24hr_change
params.description: Include 24-hour price change percentage in the response

params.name: include_last_updated_at
params.description: Include last updated timestamp in the response

params.name: precision
params.description: Decimal precision for currency price values (0-18)

items.docs: Query the prices of one or more tokens by using their contract addresses on a specific asset platform. This endpoint is useful for looking up token prices when you have the contract address rather than the CoinGecko coin ID.
Get the list of all supported vs currencies (fiat and crypto) that can be used in price queries.

info.name: Get token prices by contract addresses

params.name: network
params.description: The blockchain network identifier (e.g., eth, bsc, polygon_pos, solana, arbitrum, avalanche, base)

params.name: addresses
params.description: Comma-separated list of token contract addresses (up to 30)

items.docs: Get the USD prices of multiple tokens on a specific network by their contract addresses. Returns the latest price data for each requested token.
